_comment: Editorial content for SPAC1. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: no licence-cleared photograph of the company's own facilities exists, and a generic industry photograph would imply it is theirs. Add imagePath/imageSource/imageLicence together when a real one is available. This is a blank-cheque special purpose acquisition company: it has no operating business or products by design, and the product list is intentionally empty rather than omitted.
description: LSE SPAC-I Limited was incorporated on 20 March 2025 as Pakistan's first special purpose acquisition company, formed for the sole purpose of raising capital in an initial public offering and then merging with or acquiring an existing business. It has no commercial operations of its own: not less than 90% of IPO proceeds must be held in escrow for the acquisition, the transaction must complete within three years of listing, and otherwise the funds are returned to shareholders and the company is wound up. It is a subsidiary of LSE Capital Limited, and its prospectus names Ningbo Green Light Energy Limited as the target company, with the SPAC to take at least a 19.04% equity interest and then merge into it under a scheme of arrangement.
